Welcome! Have you ever wondered why making a real change in your life—or at work—can feel like you’re pushing a boulder uphill? You’re definitely not alone.
Most of us have felt stuck in routines that just don’t seem to budge, no matter how much we want things to be different.
That’s exactly the challenge we’ll explore together, drawing inspiration from the ideas in Switch: How to Change Things When Change Is Hard, written by Chip Heath.
What’s fascinating is how this book dives deep into the hidden reasons change is so tough—revealing the tug-of-war between our rational plans and our emotional impulses.
It’s not just about deciding what needs to change. Real progress happens when we learn how to spark motivation, shape our environment, and tune our mindset so those new habits actually stick.
Think about it: what if the key to lasting transformation isn’t just sheer willpower, but instead, making small, smart shifts that turn resistance into real movement?
By the end, you’ll have a fresh perspective on what it truly takes to create change that lasts—whether in your own life, within your team, or out in the wider world.
So, let’s step into this journey together and discover the practical tools and surprising insights that can help us all move forward.
